_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Tadakalt tamashek n Klondike Solitaire. Tanegga nnek wad aɣaras n uzzuzzu n wayyuren akken ad ten-teǧǧeɣ ɣer ussudu n uɣaras.

Tawuriwin n uzzuzzu:
- Ussudu n uɣaras (F1-F4): Rnu ɣer wayyur n Ace ɣer wayyur n King di tɣessa
- Ussudu n tawla (T1-T7): Rnu ɣer wadda n warawen (awraɣ ɣef abayɣur, abayɣur ɣef awraɣ)
- Aɣaras n yiccaren: Ssuɣel wayyuren ɣer uɣaras n yirɣan
- Uɣaras n yirɣan (W): Wayyur wiss sin yella ɣer uɣaras

Tawuriwin:
- 'draw' - Ssuɣel wayyuren ɣer uɣaras n yirɣan
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Ssuɣel wayyuren ɣer uɣaras n wayyuren
  Imedyaten: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count yezmer ad yili 'all', wad yezmer ad yili akken ad ten-teǧǧeɣ wayyuren wiss sin yella.
- 'forfeit' - Tfad adrar n uzzuzzu s yiddeɣ ɣer wakud n yimɣuren
- Isemawen n uɣaras: W (yirɣan), F1-F4 (ussudu n uɣaras), T1-T7 (ussudu n tawla)

Tazmert ad ten-teǧǧeɣ tawuriwin tuɣac di wakud wiss sin s yisekaren s tukkuzt:
  Imedyat: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Wayyuren n King wiss sin yella yezmer ad yili ɣer uɣaras n tawla wiss sin yella.
Tawuriwin ten-teǧǧeɣ di wakud wiss sin - wad yezmer ad yili wiss sin yella, tawuriwin wiss sin yella ten-teǧǧeɣ.
Sseqdec 'forfeit' wad yezmer ad yili uzzuzzu yezmer ad yili wiss sin yella.
